bullets.text: Cloudflare Pushes for Google Regulation - **Cloudflare** CEO advocates for unbundling **Google**'s AI crawlers to ensure fair competition.
Apple Watch’s Hypertension Feature - **Apple Watch** now offers hypertension notifications, expanding accessibility to older models.
Anker's Compact Nano Chargers - **Anker** introduces two new Nano chargers for **iPhone 17**, emphasizing portability and convenience.
Apple Vision Pro M5 Review - The updated **Apple Vision Pro** features a more comfortable strap and improved weight distribution.
Netflix Expands Generative AI Use - **Netflix** embraces generative AI to enhance creative processes and storytelling efficiency.
Google Fi Enhances Communication - **Google Fi** introduces AI noise filters and RCS web messaging for improved user experience.
OpenAI Launches Atlas Browser - **OpenAI** unveils its new Atlas web browser, challenging **Google** with AI-driven features.
Sesame Raises $250M for AI Glasses - **Sesame**, founded by Oculus co-founders, secures funding for its conversational AI eyewear.
Samsung Galaxy XR Launches - **Samsung**'s **Galaxy XR** headset offers a competitive alternative to **Apple**'s Vision Pro.
